हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Aryan proposes in a café, but Riya humiliates him as “NOTHING!” and leaves with rich Varun; the very next morning Aryan walks into his own billionaire empire looking calm and ordinary, and the boardroom freezes when they realize who he is; because he isn’t middle-class at all he’s the hidden CEO, and their downfall starts now.
